evidence: parse_obj_scalar.rs:15-23 uses f32 parsing without an is_finite check; decode_obj_file.rs:38-53 receives coordinates and :139-160 builds CpuMeshPayload; pipeline/types.rs:55-67 MeshVertex::new copies the values.
impact_or_question: OBJ with a NaN numeric field can return a successful CPU mesh with non-finite vertex data.
next_action: Reject non-finite OBJ scalars with a typed error and add a loader regression case.

evidence: parse_obj_face_vertex.rs:53-62 ends normal at the third slash and ignores the remainder; its compatibility test at :83-87 expects that behavior. The project importer uses tobj at importer/ingest/import_obj.rs:19-24.
impact_or_question: Determine whether accepting face tokens with extra fields is an intentional compatibility contract for background file loading.
next_action: Compare both OBJ paths on malformed face tokens and document or tighten the accepted grammar with focused tests.

evidence: cook_virtual_geometry_from_mesh is exported by asset/mod.rs:173-176 and checks only emptiness/index validity at cook.rs:46-57; cluster_bounds at :297-312 computes bounds from raw float positions; indexed_mesh_projection.rs:90-93 calls it on imported vertices.
impact_or_question: Confirm whether every entry path guarantees finite positions; otherwise derived bounds and screen-space error could be non-finite.
next_action: Trace source validation at importers and direct public callers, then add a non-finite geometry contract test.

evidence: inspection_dump.rs:243-257 accepts any seven-word payload and treats its seventh word as item_count. At :273-291 it emits a short-item line for every declared item even when the actual words are exhausted. A 28-byte header with item_count=u32::MAX therefore schedules 4,294,967,295 iterations.
impact_or_question: Inspecting a malformed asset can consume unbounded CPU and diagnostic memory despite the input payload containing only a small header.
next_action: Bound diagnostic iteration by actual available records and emit one summary for missing declared items; add a truncated-header regression test.
